test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Why is there a chaos when the family is ready to drive?

options.text: The family members did not get along well.
They do not trust the person at the wheel.
There is a disagreement over the venue.
Some family members are not comfortably seated.

solution:
The correct answer is **There is a disagreement over the venue.**
